name: partialcorr
expr: p3 = partialcorr(x, y, z); R1 = partialcorr(X); R2 = partialcorr(X, Z); R3 = partialcorr(X2);
comment: Sig: r = partialcorr(X), partialcorr(X, Z), partialcorr(X, Y, Z). Pearson partial correlation. 1-arg form: pair-specific control = other X cols. 2-arg form: control = Z. 3-arg form: cross-correlation residualised on Z. Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on deterministic data. Forms 1+2 added cycle 85.
